from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its title and the cause of action it contains."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) stated in the document text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
